notes: Pass 1: contractorforeman.com answered HTTP 403 with a challenge page to the first two requests (home, and pricing, which redirected to /plans/); no further request was made to that host. Review ratings (Capterra 4.5 from 800+ reviews), feature and module counts ('over 40 tools', 'over 25 other modules') and evaluative 'transparent pricing' lines were not coded. Pass 2 (8 Oct): the four pages in needs_browser_read were each read once in a real browser. The plans page (annual prices shown: Basic $49 for 1 user, Standard $105 up to 3, Plus $166 up to 8, Pro $221 up to 15, Unlimited $332; 30-day free trial; FAQ on price basis, devices, hosting and integrations) settles every claim: 19 are true and three are wrong. C04 ($49 for up to three users), C05 ($49 per user) and C11 (free tier for one user) are wrong against the same plans page, like with like (entry price and user limit, price basis, the one-user tier). For causes, six cited pages were read once each (simplysub, thecfoclub (403), buildbite, mastt, archdesk, ustechautomations); none carries the three statements (archdesk gives '$49/month' with no user basis, buildbite '$49 for annual plans'), so all three are 'cause not found'. Added: C23 (subscription pricing, from a table cell and one sentence) and one table-cell instance of C03 (q3 Claude 3). The price comparison page is dated 'As of September 23, 2022' and was not used as proof. Reviewer: look first at C11, which rests on the plans page listing every plan as paid (Basic $49 for one user after the trial) rather than on a sentence saying there is no free plan.
